Introducing 1435 s. Astor, one of seven new construction two-flats coming to the Gold Coast—where thoughtful design and elevated everyday living come together in a fresh, modern way. From the moment you arrive, the blend of brick and hardie siding sets a strong, contemporary tone for what is inside. The home is designed around how people actually live—open, connected spaces, abundant natural light, and finishes that feel cohesive from room to room. Wide-plank LVT flooring runs throughout, paired with 5\" baseboards and crown molding for an elevated aesthetic. The kitchen is the heart of it all—anchored by a striking black-and-white cabinetry contrast that brings a timeless, architectural edge. Quartz countertops, a large central island, custom cabinetry, and a full GE stainless steel appliance package come together to create a space built to be a conversation starter. From the kitchen, the space naturally opens into the family room—centered around a sleek fireplace and framed by expansive west-facing windows that draw in soft afternoon light. Built-in nooks are thoughtfully placed beside the windows, creating a quiet space to sit, reset, or simply take in the view. From here, the layout flows directly onto the rear deck. Upstairs, the primary suite is designed as a private escape. The spa-inspired bath features a walk-in glass shower with full-body sprayers, a dual vanity, and a freestanding soaking tub, paired with curated finishes from Kohler, Delta, and signature hardware. Two additional bedrooms and a second-floor laundry area complete the level with everyday practicality in mind. The garden unit adds incredible flexibility with 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths, and a private entrance—ideal guest or house-hacking opportunity: live comfortably in the main residence while offsetting your mortgage with income from the garden unit. A two-car garage and a spacious backyard round out the home, offering both convenience and room to enjoy. Located near the Newberry Library and Oak Street Beach, with quick access to the Red Line and just minutes from the Magnificent Mile and downtown Chicago—this home places culture, luxury, and city energy all within easy reach. Model home: 2435 w. Rush St.
